title: CKODEX STX Event v1
description: Schema for events emitted by an STX publisher (harness) on the event stream. One event per state-changing action. Events are ordered by sequence number per session and timestamp globally.

sequence.description: Per-session monotonic. Consumers MUST reject out-of-order events from the same sessionId.

payload.description: Event-type-specific payload. Shape determined by eventType (renderers may flatten).

redacted.description: Field paths that were redacted to satisfy privacyMode. Permits round-trip reconstruction by privileged consumers.
